headline: VAT on parcels worth up to 150 euros planned in Ukraine: what the Rada decided
summary: The Verkhovna Rada failed for a second time to adopt a proposal that would change rules for Ukrainians ordering goods from abroad, including VAT on parcels up to 150 euros. Lawmakers again lacked the votes.
why: Import duty and VAT rules on cross-border e-commerce affect consumer prices and retailers handling foreign online orders. Ukraine's tax policy also matters for budget revenue.
